issues.quote: what weighs is that every time it demands attention, that I am no longer master of it, it is master of me
In fact you become the slave of this many-headed beast.
If only for a while I could free myself of it, forget, rest.
I cannot get out of a man's way.
While on mine, everywhere and always, I meet a human being.
you who through the windows of houses, thousands of black mouths, forever breathe out your stench
You want to suck me dry, all my blood, like a vampire.
you roar with pain, with joy, with rage. Like a beast.

strengths.quote: like air through windows and doors, like the waters of tributaries into a river
I confess I envy the planets: they have their orbits, and nothing stands in their path.
strengths.why: fresh, wry, true to the weary voice

strengths.quote: You flog the holy silence of the earth with the grinding of factories and the thunder of wheels
You toss into my heart, as into your own storeroom, your sufferings and your pains
your eyes, curious, greedy, crawl into me
